caption:
Use await inside forEach in an interview and the follow-up question is always "so when does the toast show?"

Look at the card. The await works inside each callback, but forEach doesn't wait for any of them. It starts every callback, ignores the promises they return, and moves on. The toast shows while the uploads are still running.

Two fixes:
for...of with await uploads one file at a time, in order.
await Promise.all(files.map(upload)) uploads them in parallel and waits for all of them.

Pick in order when the server cares about order, parallel when it doesn't.

Source: MDN, Array.prototype.forEach() (it expects a synchronous function).
